summary: Re-tested Cricsheet ingestion, history APIs, and responsive dashboard. Two imports both produced 1,243 matches, identical archive hash, and exactly one ingestion-run record; public API and desktop history checks passed with real metrics.

issues: At 390px width, sidebar navigation labels remain visible and spill over the main content area; icons-only mobile navigation should hide the link text or clip it cleanly.

action_items: Fix mobile sidebar nav labels overlapping page content at widths <=650px.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing persisted Cricsheet data and live fixture feed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ingestion idempotency, history meta/list/analytics, source attribution, chart, market row, no wagering controls, mobile horizontal overflow, and live fixture explorer were tested. Only mobile sidebar visual overlap remains.
rca of the issue: The <=650px CSS hides .brand text and several sidebar status elements but does not hide the text nodes inside nav links. The fixed 58px aside therefore renders labels outside its narrow rail over the main content. Add a mobile rule to hide nav link text (or use an icon-label strategy) while preserving accessible names.
test_credentials: Not applicable; app has no auth.
